== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-02-soulsmith|The [[Sandvipers|Sandviper]] sect is a group of [[sacred artists]] that maintains an alliance with the [[Jai clan]], specifically collaborating on expeditions within the [[Ruins]]. Their territory within the [[Five Factions Alliance]] was not formally designated but was instead acquired through conquest and occupation. While their leadership resides in a large, ornate red tent, the lower-ranking members live in much simpler structures made of scavenged materials and wood. The sect is known for utilizing insidious, venomous powers capable of dissolving flesh with acid-like properties. This combat style is rooted in a [[Path]] originally developed in the swamps as an adaptation to the corruption found in the [[Desolate Wilds|Wilds]]. To manage the lethal nature of their own toxins, members utilize a technique known as the [[Bloodforged Iron body]]. This practice requires initiates to consume the blood of a [[sandviper]], which assists in regulating the venom and prevents it from destroying their internal organs.}}

== Soulsmith ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-02-soulsmith|Located within the [[Desolate Wilds]], the [[Sandvipers|Sandviper]] sect is a half-civilized group allied with the [[Jai clan]]. Led by their young chief, [[Sandviper Kral|Kral]], the sect's members utilize [[green madra]] and a venomous aura. Their initiates undergo training involving the [[Bloodforged Iron body]], and the group includes a member named [[Sandviper Gokren|Gokren]]. During an infiltration mission, both [[Lindon]] and [[Yerin]] disguised themselves using [[Sandvipers|Sandviper]] sect outfits.}}
